verdict.rationale: Graphite documents per-repo AI review enablement ('few clicks', 'selected repositories') plus custom rules and comment exclusions for tailoring agent behavior (graphite-docs-5, graphite-docs-18, graphite-docs-19, graphite-docs-20), which supports exception-style configuration, but there is no evidence of an org-wide admin console, bulk policy rollout mechanism, or centralized dashboard for managing defaults/exceptions across hundreds of repos simultaneously. Missing for 10: org-level default-setting UI/API, bulk repo enrollment tooling, and any documented mechanism for centrally tracking/overriding exceptions at scale.
